top_signals.title: AMD, Intel Soar as Meta’s Muse AI Agent Spurs Chip Stock Rally
top_signals.summary: Semiconductor stocks soared Monday as early signs of success for Meta Platforms Inc.’s new artificial intelligence agent sparked a wave of enthusiasm around demand for the chips needed to power such agents.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: NYC Airports Disrupted by Air Traffic Control Outage
top_signals.summary: Flights at New York’s major airports were disrupted after a technical problem at an air traffic control facility in Philadelphia. A so-called ground stop was in effect at John F. Kennedy International, LaGuardia, and Newark Liberty International. Sid Philip reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trump and Xi are the wrong men at the wrong time
top_signals.summary: The world needs far-sighted leadership but the US and Chinese leaders are unlikely to provide it

top_signals.title: ‘A little more orange’: Strategy buys 950 bitcoin for $76 million, bringing total holdings to 846,000 BTC
top_signals.summary: Strategy's total holdings account for around 4% of the 21 million bitcoin supply cap — worth roughly $72 billion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
